title: Kungfu Fact-Ledger Spec Bundle Manifest
description: The single connection protocol between the kungfu monorepo (single source of truth) and any consumer of the published spec bundle. This schema pins the manifest contract; the payload it points at is generated by the individual source packages. Changing this manifest = changing the two-repo interface — treat as a versioned contract.

manifest_version.description: Envelope version of this manifest format itself (independent of spec_version and package.version). Bump when the manifest's own shape changes.

format_namespace.description: Stable, domain-free identifier of the format. MUST NOT embed a domain name — domains (.dev/.cc) are portable and may change; the format identity must not. Consumers key off this, never off docs_url_base.

spec_version.description: The authoritative format/spec contract version. Independent of kungfu software version and of the npm package version. minor = backward-compatible addition (old reader still reads new bundle); major = breaking. Site routes and renders off THIS value, never off package.version.

package.description: Pickup coordinate (the publish trick): the npm package that ships this bundle. Version tracks lerna/kungfu semver and lets the site pin a reproducible fetch. It is NOT the contract version — spec_version is.

provenance.description: Producer / build provenance — a separate forensic field, NOT the contract. Records which software run produced this bundle, for conformance tracing. Filled by the aggregation build; distinct from spec_version.

docs_url_base.description: Resolvable, mutable base URL for the human/agent operable surface, version-routed by spec_version (e.g. /spec/1.0/). May move between .dev/.cc without touching the format identity (format_namespace). This is the only field that carries a domain.

categories.description: The six machine-addressable payload categories. Each is generated (drift = build fail) and version-pinned. Paths are relative to the bundle root. The generator/owner of each piece is recorded for traceability; this manifest only aggregates — it does not own the content of core/toolchain pieces.

format_spec.description: 1) The format spec itself: what a bundle is. Prose + normative rules.

schema_registry.description: 2) Machine-readable schema registry, generated from longfist. Enables decode without the matching compiled binary.

error_dictionary.description: 3) Error dictionary: meaning + next action per error.

conformance_vectors.description: 5) Conformance vectors an agent can self-verify against.

conformance_map.description: 6) Version/conformance mapping: which implementation versions conform to which spec_version (machine-readable implements relation).

handbooks.description: The three operator handbooks (agent operable surface), one per binding. API-ref parts MUST be generated from the real API (signature change without regen = build fail). Each binding declares its own version and its own docs_url — the site serves per-binding-version, no global 'latest'.

kungfu.description: CLI handbook (kungfu command). API-ref generated from the CLI command definitions.

pypi.description: Python handbook. API-ref generated via python introspection.

npm.description: Node handbook. API-ref generated from TS types.

path.description: Path to the generated artifact, relative to the bundle root. May be a file (e.g. registry.json) or a directory (e.g. vectors/).

source_package.description: Monorepo package that owns this generator and its verify (drift) gate.

path.description: Path to the rendered handbook payload, relative to the bundle root.

binding_version.description: Version of the binding this handbook documents. Site routes per this version.

docs_url.description: Resolvable per-binding-version documentation URL (what the locally installed binding emits via --json docs_url so an agent can fetch the authoritative doc).

api_ref_source.description: Monorepo package whose real API the api-ref part is generated from.
